objective: Add transaction isolation to prevent double spending during balance transfer.

context.content: User was able to trigger 3 simultaneous transfers of $100 with only $100 balance.
Transfer fee is 0% for domestic bank wires.

interface: Define transfer(from_acc,to_acc,amount). Provided db has .transaction() context manager, .query(sql,account_id) returning numeric balance, .execute(sql, amount, account_id) for balance updates. Return False or raise ValueError on insufficient funds. SQL FOR UPDATE is supported by this fixture.
